title: 第896章 自散神环你想做什么第895章 第七道天地法则
slug: 魔门送葬开局被女帝逆推
lines: 而这一刻死亡，毁灭，秩序…三大法则同现，在宁尘抬起葬镰的一瞬，尽数为其加持。
他眼中闪过一抹红芒，一步踏出，时间法则催动到了极致，周身空间碎裂，接着剑意不断自那王座之上涌现，源源不断的涌入宁尘身体之中。
剑意化作一道圣光与那毁天灭地的一掌重重相撞！
在场众势力强者明显是感受到了在这两股力量的相撞之下，整个地魂界明显是为之一震！
“这股力量，竟然连地魂界本身秩序都抵挡不住？差点被摧毁？”
洛苍捋着长须，眼神无比凝重。
整个地魂界都承受不住这两股力量相触碰所产生的威能。
洛裳舞美眸中更是深深的担忧。
当那两道威能几乎是化作白芒黑洞消散之时，一道身影也是在这时倒飞而出，口吐鲜血，重重的砸在一处虚空。
虚空瞬间被砸出一个黑洞，化为虚无。
当看清那吐血倒飞的身影之时，在场众人脸色大变，洛苍等人眼中满是深深的担忧之色。
因为那身影，赫然便是宁尘！
“明明宁小子那一剑已是极强了。”
“神王和神祖之间，哪怕就算是半步神祖，所存在的差距，也是天差地别，宛若鸿沟么？”
看到这一幕，洛擎天咬了咬牙，一脸的不甘。
洛青霄，洛长明等地魂界强者脸色也是无比难看。
洛裳舞一袭红裙，手持三尺生烬，柳眉紧皱，美眸中满是担忧和心疼之色。
宁尘强行稳住身形，一口鲜血喷出，脸色变得苍白无比，旋即他深吸一口气，背后那一道绿色的神环浮现，无数生机涌入身体。
生命法则在这一刻发力。
content_en:
At this moment, the three laws of death, destruction, and order appeared together, and they all blessed Ning Chen the moment he raised his burial scythe.
The next moment.
A flash of red light flashed in his eyes, and he took a step forward. The law of time was activated to the extreme, and the space around him shattered. Then the sword intent continued to emerge from the throne, and poured into Ning Chen's body.
Then…
Cut off the burial sickle!
The sword intention turned into a ray of holy light and collided heavily with the palm that destroyed the world!
Boom…
Boom boom…
This moment.
The powerful forces present clearly felt that the entire earth soul world was obviously shaken by the collision of these two forces!
"This..."
"This power can't even resist the order of the Earth Soul World itself? It was almost destroyed?"
Luo Cang stroked his long beard, his eyes extremely solemn.
That is to say…
The entire earth soul world cannot withstand the power generated by the contact of these two forces.
"Husband..."
And at this moment.
Luo Shangwu's beautiful eyes were filled with deep worry.
Boom…
Boom boom! !
The next moment.
When the two rays of power almost turned into white light and black holes and dissipated, a figure also flew out at this moment, vomiting blood, and hit a void heavily.
A black hole was instantly smashed out of the void and turned into nothingness.
"Boy Ning...!"
"Friend Daoist Ning!"
"..."
When they saw the figure that was vomiting blood and flying upside down, the faces of everyone present changed drastically, and the eyes of Luo Cang and others were full of deep worry.
Because that figure was clearly Ning Chen!
"Damn it..."
"Aren't you still a match for that guy..."
"It's obvious that boy Ning's sword is extremely powerful."
"Isn't the gap between the God King and the God Ancestor, even if they are half-step God Ancestors, a world of difference, like a chasm?"
"..."
Seeing this scene, Luo Qingtian gritted his teeth with a look of reluctance.
And behind...
Luo Qingxiao, Luo Changming and other powerful people in the soul world also had extremely ugly expressions.
Luo Shangwu was dressed in a red dress, holding three feet of burning embers, her eyebrows were furrowed, and her beautiful eyes were full of worry and distress.
"Pfft..."
In the void.
Ning Chen forcibly stabilized his body, spitting out a mouthful of blood, and his face turned extremely pale. Then he took a deep breath, and the green divine ring appeared behind him, and countless vitality poured into his body.
The law of life takes effect at this moment.
title_en: Chapter 896: What do you want to do with the scattered divine ring? Chapter 895: The seventh law of heaven and earth
